why: R60 attempt 3 canary grows 13-27 GiB per harness feature unit on C: (each relinks every harness test binary); the Studio C: tree will reach the 368 GiB clean stop inside the 400 GB grant before the canary ends
method: read-only os.scandir of target/debug/deps, sizes by extension, 2026-11-13
reading: About 65% of deps is .pdb debug symbols and about 19% .exe; a reduced test/dev debuginfo profile (e.g. line-tables-only, or no debuginfo for third-party packages) would cut the largest share of every lane target and of each round unit. UNVERIFIED: exact savings until measured on one lane after the change.
proposal_for_operator: Product build-config change in the product repo (a lane, not lead tools): reduce debuginfo for dev/test profiles. Cost: one full rebuild per target and a full canary (root input change). Benefit: smaller targets for all lanes and rounds, letting the full canary fit the C: grant. Alternatives: more C: room, or the round on D: during a builder pause.
